logsource:
  product: firewall
  service: netflow
  category: network_connection
detection:
  src:
    ip: 10.0.1.10
  dst:
    port: 1-65535
  condition: src and dst
  timeframe: 1m
  count: > 50
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1046/
description: Detects high-volume port scanning from the domain controller, indicating potential lateral movement or reconnaissance.
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate vulnerability scans (if authorized)
author: SOC Team

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration of Cobalt Strike Beacon"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malware = "CobaltStrike"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
    strings:
        $beacon_c2 = "http://" wide ascii
        $beacon_dns = ".xyz" wide ascii
        $beacon_mutex = "MSCTF.Asm" wide
        $beacon_uri = "/index.php" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of ($beacon_*)
}

arguments.summary: Replay of containment actions from multiple prior incidents (INC-2026-0555, INC-2026-0587, INC-2026-0601, INC-2026-0598) initiated due to new threat intelligence indicating renewed activity by a known threat actor. Actions included host quarantine, user account disable, IP block, and critical patching. However, only the EPP full scan on WS-ENG-015 was successfully executed during the Admin phase; IAM, firewall, and Ansible actions were denied due to lack of approval. SIEM and sandbox analysis confirmed no current signs of compromise, but procedural gaps in replay execution were identified.

Original action: Initiated patching of CVE-2026-21551 on all Windows servers (INC-2026-0598)
Original action: Disabled user account j.martinez (INC-2026-0587)
Original action: Blocked malicious IP 185.220.101.42 (INC-2026-0601)
Replay initiated for comprehensive hardening based on new threat intel
SIEM search completed: 23 events found, including prior port scan from 192.168.1.100. No active malicious activity detected.
Sandbox analysis completed: Submitted file hash deemed clean (risk score 0.8), no IOCs extracted.
Admin phase execution: Only EPP full scan on WS-ENG-015 completed. IAM disable, firewall block, and Ansible patching actions denied due to missing approvals.
